**ERRORS — README.md "Freshness — Covered command paths" block (lines 429–457)**

This list is largely fabricated relative to the shipped command tree. Ground truth: `activities` has subcommands `annotations|athletes|devices|get|list|periods`; `athletes` has `annotations|bands|list`; `sensor` has `data|devices|efforts|events`; `venues` has `get|list`; and `annotations`, `parameters`, `teams` are leaf commands with no subcommands at all. Specifically:

| File:Line | Severity | Finding | Fix |
|---|---|---|---|
| README.md:433 | error | `activities search` is not a subcommand of `activities` | Remove; searching is `search "<q>" --type activities` |
| README.md:435–437 | error | `annotations get/list/search` don't exist — `annotations` is a leaf ("List annotation categories") | Replace with bare `annotations` |
| README.md:439 | error | `athletes get` doesn't exist (subs: annotations, bands, list) | Remove or change to `athletes list` |

| README.md:447–449 | error | `sensor get/list/search` don't exist (subs: data, devices, efforts, events) | Replace with the real sensor subcommands |
| README.md:451–453 | error | `teams get/list/search` don't exist — `teams` is a leaf | Replace with bare `teams` |
| README.md:457 | error | `venues search` doesn't exist (subs: get, list) | Remove; use `search --type venues` |

|---|---|---|---|
